name: Drought recurrence
description: Return period or scenario frequency for a precisely defined drought event and basin.

name: Reservoir inflows
description: Observed or assumed inflow volume or normalized index for a named reservoir system and period.

name: Snowpack assumption
description: Snow-water-equivalent index as a percentage of normal for a named basin and bulletin date.

name: Copper price
description: Specified copper benchmark price, with benchmark, market, frequency and real or nominal price basis retained in source metadata.

name: Critical mineral demand
description: Demand for a named mineral under a named scenario, expressed in physical units or an index; mineral and end use are required dimensions.

name: Japan LNG import price proxy
description: World Bank monthly Japan LNG import price series. This is a public proxy and is not Platts JKM.

name: LNG price (JKM)
description: Platts Japan Korea Marker price or a clearly labelled public proxy; proprietary JKM values must not be republished without suitable rights.

name: AECO natural gas price
description: Specified AECO or Alberta NIT benchmark, with product, delivery period and administrator retained in metadata.

name: Henry Hub natural gas price
description: Henry Hub natural gas spot price for the stated reference period.

name: Brent oil price
description: Europe Brent spot price.

name: WTI oil price
description: Cushing, Oklahoma West Texas Intermediate spot price.

name: Annual electricity demand
description: Annual electrical energy demand for a defined system, customer scope and weather-treatment basis.

name: Electricity load growth rate
description: Compound annual growth rate in annual electricity demand over the stated forecast interval.

name: Construction inflation
description: Year-over-year percentage change in the Statistics Canada Building Construction Price Index for aggregate non-residential construction in Vancouver.

name: Vancouver non-residential construction price index
description: Quarterly aggregate non-residential building construction price index for Vancouver.

name: All-items CPI index
description: Monthly all-items Consumer Price Index for British Columbia.

name: Inflation
description: Year-over-year percentage change in the all-items Consumer Price Index for British Columbia.

name: Employment growth
description: Percentage change in seasonally adjusted employment from the same month one year earlier.

name: Employment
description: Seasonally adjusted number of employed persons aged 15 years and over in British Columbia, after applying the Statistics Canada scalar factor.

name: CAD per USD exchange rate
description: Daily average Canadian-dollar value of one United States dollar.

name: Household growth
description: Percentage change in the estimated or projected number of private households from the preceding year.

name: Households
description: Estimated or projected number of private households in British Columbia; collective dwellings excluded.

name: Housing starts growth (SAAR)
description: Percentage change in British Columbia total housing starts at a seasonally adjusted annual rate from the same month one year earlier.

name: Housing starts (SAAR)
description: CMHC housing starts in British Columbia, seasonally adjusted at an annual rate, for the reference month.

name: Government of Canada 10-year benchmark yield
description: Daily yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond.

name: Bank of Canada target overnight rate
description: Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate on the reference date.

name: Labour force growth
description: Percentage change in the seasonally adjusted labour force from the same month one year earlier.

name: Labour force
description: Seasonally adjusted number of persons aged 15 years and over in the labour force in British Columbia, after applying the Statistics Canada scalar factor.

name: Population growth
description: Percentage change in the estimated resident population of British Columbia from the same reference period one year earlier.

name: Population
description: Estimated resident population of British Columbia at the reference date.

name: Real GDP growth
description: Annual percentage change in real gross domestic product for British Columbia.

name: Building electrification rate
description: Annual share of the specified building stock converting a named end use from fossil fuel to electricity.

name: EV stock
description: Registered in-use light-duty or total electric vehicles, with vehicle and powertrain scope specified.

name: EV stock growth
description: Year-over-year percentage change in the defined electric-vehicle stock.

name: Heat pump adoption
description: Share of the specified building or equipment stock using a defined heat-pump technology.

name: Heat pump installed cost
description: Installed cost for a defined heat-pump type and building archetype, with rebate, tax, electrical-upgrade and dollar-year treatment specified.

name: Residential electric heating-system stock
description: NRCan estimate of electric residential heating systems in British Columbia, excluding the separately identified heat-pump category.

name: Residential heat-pump share
description: NRCan estimate of heat pumps as a share of residential heating-system stock in British Columbia.

name: Residential heat-pump heating-system stock
description: NRCan estimate of residential heat-pump heating systems in British Columbia.

name: Residential natural-gas heating-system stock
description: Combined NRCan estimate of medium- and high-efficiency natural-gas residential heating systems in British Columbia.

name: Cost of debt
description: Embedded, forecast or allowed cost of debt, with issuer, regulatory treatment and period specified.

name: Cost of equity
description: Forecast or allowed return on equity, with methodology, capital structure and period specified.

name: Discount rate
description: Discount rate used in a named analysis, with nominal/real and pre-/post-tax basis specified.

name: WACC
description: Nominal or real weighted average cost of capital, before or after tax as explicitly identified.

name: AI compute growth
description: Annual growth in a specified measure of AI training or inference compute, with scope and denominator retained.

name: Data centre power intensity
description: Electrical demand per defined unit of data-centre capacity or floor area; denominator and load convention are required.

name: Data centre realization rate
description: Derived probability that a data-centre proposal at a defined development stage reaches construction or commercial operation within a stated time horizon.

name: LNG realization rate
description: Derived probability that a project at a defined development stage reaches a defined realized stage within a stated time horizon.

name: Mining realization rate
description: Derived probability that a mining project at a defined development stage reaches construction or commercial operation within a stated time horizon.

name: Construction lead times
description: Elapsed time between defined project milestones for a named infrastructure class.

name: Transformer lead times
description: Elapsed time from order to delivery for a specified transformer class and procurement market.

name: ELCC assumption
description: Effective load-carrying capability as a share of nameplate capacity for a defined resource, duration, penetration level, system and target year.

name: Electricity import cost
description: Observed or assumed electricity import cost, including market, delivery point, currency and price basis.

name: Canadian electricity export value
description: Monthly value of international electricity exports from Canada, including capacity charges where reported.

name: Canadian electricity exports
description: Monthly international electricity exports from Canada reported by the Canada Energy Regulator.

name: Canadian electricity import value
description: Monthly value of international electricity imports to Canada, including capacity charges where reported.

name: Canadian electricity imports
description: Monthly international electricity imports to Canada reported by the Canada Energy Regulator.

name: Western Canada electricity export price
description: CER monthly weighted-average international electricity export price for the western region, which includes B.C., Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

name: Western Canada electricity import price
description: CER monthly weighted-average international electricity import price for the western region, which includes B.C., Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

name: Import energy availability
description: Energy available for import over a defined period and under a named market, hydrological or reliability condition.

name: Reserve margin
description: Planning reserve margin for a defined system, season, planning year and capacity-accreditation convention.

name: Battery cost curve
description: Installed battery-system cost for a defined chemistry, duration, power/energy basis, scenario, target year and dollar year.

name: Hydrogen cost curve
description: Levelized hydrogen production cost for a defined production pathway, electricity price, utilization, scenario, region and dollar year.

name: Solar cost curve
description: Capital cost for a defined solar technology, scale, scenario, target year, region and dollar year.

name: Wind cost curve
description: Capital cost for a defined wind technology, resource class, scenario, target year, region and dollar year.
